Jatin Nair
Senior Java Developer | New Delhi
jatin.nair802@example.com | +91 9275002369

Versatile Java developer focused on building reliable, high-throughput backend systems. Strong track record delivering microservices and event-driven features that improve throughput and reduce latency. Seeking to continue applying scalable architecture and data integrity practices in production environments. Notice period: 30 days.

Experience

Vertex Analytics — Jun 2024 - Present
Java Developer | Remote
- Implemented microservices using Java and Spring Boot to process streaming financial events, reducing end-to-end processing latency by 28% while increasing throughput to 12k events/sec; coordinated schema evolution and consumer compatibility via Apache Kafka.
- Designed MySQL schemas and optimized queries, cutting average query time for transaction lookups from 420ms to 85ms and reducing DB CPU by 35% through indexing and partitioning.
- Built REST APIs for internal analytics dashboards with contract tests and API versioning, improving developer onboarding and decreasing production incidents by 40%.
- Introduced Git branching standards and participated in Agile ceremonies, accelerating feature delivery by introducing CI checks and regular retrospective-driven improvements.

Paystack India — Jun 2021 - May 2024
Software Engineer | On-site
- Developed and maintained payment microservices in Java and Spring Boot handling peak loads of 20k TPS, leveraging Apache Kafka for reliable event propagation and achieving 99.95% message delivery SLA.
- Implemented idempotent REST APIs and transactional patterns with MySQL to ensure consistency across payment and reconciliation flows, reducing failed reconciliation cases by 62%.
- Led performance tuning of Kafka consumers and producer batching, improving processing throughput by 3x and lowering tail latency for settlement jobs by 47%.
- Drove Git-based release workflows and Agile sprint planning, contributing to cross-team integrations and reducing average lead time for changes from 9 days to 4 days.

Projects
- Real-time Fraud Alert Simulator — Built a small-scale simulator combining Kafka producers/consumers and Spring Boot microservices to emulate transaction spikes and validate alerting logic; used MySQL to persist simulated incidents and measure end-to-end latency.
- API Contract Tester — Created a lightweight REST API contract test suite using Java to validate backward compatibility across services before deployments, catching several breaking changes pre-release.

Languages: Java

Datastore & Messaging: MySQL, Apache Kafka
